description: Northern Province Provincial Council - Northern Province Indigenous Medicine statute, No. 09 of 2016
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the enactment of the "Northern Province Indigenous Medicine Statute No. 09 of 2016," which establishes a new legal framework for indigenous medicine in the Northern Province. It creates a new government department, outlines its objectives and activities, and establishes regulatory requirements for indigenous medicine practitioners and institutions. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves the creation of new legislation and regulatory frameworks rather than focusing on government personnel changes or organizational structure without legal implications.
